requirements.text: The ATM system shall prevent accounts from entering negative balances through secure transaction validation.
The ATM system shall allow withdrawals only when sufficient funds are available in both checking and savings accounts.
The ATM system shall ensure users are informed of insufficient funds before processing withdrawal transactions.
The ATM system shall securely log all transactions, including date, time, type, amount, and updated balance.
The ATM system shall implement secure user authentication via a PIN code mechanism.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The ATM system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
The ATM system shall assess the environmental impact of its operations annually and report findings to stakeholders.
The ATM system shall automatically shut down during periods of inactivity to save energy.
